messages:
maria_s: Quick question — we're onboarding a customer that requires Azure Key Vault for envelope encryption in their Private deployment. Do we prefer RBAC + Managed Identity or legacy Access Policies for the app/service principal?
alex_r: RBAC + user-assigned managed identity is our direction for new work. Allows finer role assignments and audit events in AAD.
maria_s: Got it. Any caveats with cross-tenant scenarios? This tenant is using a shared AAD with multiple subscriptions.
ben_platform: Cross-tenant = pain. If the KV is in a different tenant than the workload's AAD app, MSI won't auto-work. You need guest account or service principal in the KV's tenant, or federation. We did this for client X and ended up creating a service principal in the KV tenant and granting it Key Vault Crypto User role.
alex_r: Another thing — when you switch a vault from Access Policies to RBAC (Azure AD authorization), there is a ~5-15m propagation delay and some portals/providers still call the AccessPolicy endpoints which fail. Plan for a brief rollout window.
maria_s: Is there an audit logs gap when toggling? Compliance will ask if any events are missed during the switch.
oncall-sre: We've seen a short window where AzureActivity records the switch but keys operations return 403 until role assignments propagate. Not usually lost events, but operations blocked. Recommend notifying customer and schedule a low-traffic cutover.
ben_platform: For envelope encryption we also need decrypt access for the KMS key. Grant the managed identity the "Key Vault Crypto User" role on the key scope (or specific key). For RBAC: scope should be /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>/keys/<keyName>.
maria_s: Can we script the exact az commands for reproducibility?
alex_r: Sure, example for role assignment with user-assigned identity:```bash
# create assignment
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <msi-object-id> --assignee-principal-type ServicePrincipal --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>/keys/<key>
```
alex_r: And service principal approach:```bash
az ad sp create --id <appId>  # if needed
az role assignment create --assignee <appId> --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope <key-scope>
```
maria_s: Thanks. What about key rotation — if we rotate the key in KV (new key version), does envelope metadata need to change? We store key version in envelope headers.
ben_platform: Yes store key version (key id versioned URI). When rotating we write new envelopes with new key version. Old envelopes still decrypt with old key version as long as key isn't soft-deleted. Make sure rotation process includes: create new key version, update config to point to versioned key, warm caches, and run a small replay test.
oncall-sre: Also ensure Key Vault purge protection & soft-delete are enabled — otherwise old key versions might be gone and decryption will break.
maria_s: Audit/eventing — how do we wire Key Vault logs to our central auditing? We need key wrap/unwrap and role assignment changes logged.
oncall-sre: Export AzureDiagnostics (KeyVaultRequests) to Log Analytics / EventHub. Also pull AzureActivity for role assignment and AAD sign-in logs for MSI usage. Set alerts on 401/403 spikes and on role assignment changes.
azurebot: [system] New policy detected: key-vault-audit-forwarding. Recommended: forward KeyVaultAuditLogs to sec-log-evt hub.
ben_platform: One more gotcha — if vault has firewall/vnet enabled, the managed identity from customer VMs might not reach KV unless private endpoint is used. For Private deployments we typically recommend private endpoint+DNS.
maria_s: Good call. I'll compile a runbook: 1) choose RBAC + user-assigned MSI, 2) grant Key Vault Crypto User on key scope, 3) enable soft-delete & purge protection, 4) configure diagnostics to LA/EH, 5) use private endpoint if on VNet, 6) test rotation flow.
alex_r: Ping me when draft is ready, I can add az cli snippets and ARM/Bicep examples.
maria_s: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
